meta.title: Engrammatic Eclipse - Memory Bond - Darkstar Hubble

units.rawText: Hehehe, the stars have long since preordained your arrival, Professor, and they've told me about the guidance you need.
units.displayText: Hehehe, the stars have long since preordained your arrival, Professor, and they've told me about the guidance you need.

spans.text: Hehehe, the stars have long since preordained your arrival, Professor, and they've told me about the guidance you need.

units.rawText: When I first met you, Professor, you captivated me like the stars in the night sky. Whether it was the moment you appeared out of nowhere to save us all, or everything you've done for us since then... you've shone as brightly as the sun.
units.displayText: When I first met you, Professor, you captivated me like the stars in the night sky. Whether it was the moment you appeared out of nowhere to save us all, or everything you've done for us since then... you've shone as brightly as the sun.

spans.text: When I first met you, Professor, you captivated me like the stars in the night sky. Whether it was the moment you appeared out of nowhere to save us all, or everything you've done for us since then... you've shone as brightly as the sun.

units.rawText: Even as my memories blur with time, I'll always hold onto the moments we shared... especially our "reunion", which left the strongest impression on my heart.
units.displayText: Even as my memories blur with time, I'll always hold onto the moments we shared... especially our "reunion", which left the strongest impression on my heart.

spans.text: Even as my memories blur with time, I'll always hold onto the moments we shared... especially our "reunion", which left the strongest impression on my heart.

units.rawText: The time we spent on the Red Star... I can still feel my neural cloud stirring to no ends...
units.displayText: The time we spent on the Red Star... I can still feel my neural cloud stirring to no ends...

spans.text: The time we spent on the Red Star... I can still feel my neural cloud stirring to no ends...

units.rawText: Fufufu, the starry sky of Magrasea is so much like the Red Star—burning, falling, and dispersing... What an intriguing scene.
units.displayText: Fufufu, the starry sky of Magrasea is so much like the Red Star—burning, falling, and dispersing... What an intriguing scene.

spans.text: Fufufu, the starry sky of Magrasea is so much like the Red Star—burning, falling, and dispersing... What an intriguing scene.

units.rawText: Professor, do you think our star of fate will also meet its end under this sky?
units.displayText: Professor, do you think our star of fate will also meet its end under this sky?

spans.text: Professor, do you think our star of fate will also meet its end under this sky?

units.rawText: ...Perhaps we're like the stars, destined to fall one day, but this sky of void shan't be where we end.
units.displayText: ...Perhaps we're like the stars, destined to fall one day, but this sky of void shan't be where we end.

spans.text: ...Perhaps we're like the stars, destined to fall one day, but this sky of void shan't be where we end.

units.rawText: "This sky of void shan't be where we end", you say... Fufufu, not a bad answer.
units.displayText: "This sky of void shan't be where we end", you say... Fufufu, not a bad answer.

spans.text: "This sky of void shan't be where we end", you say... Fufufu, not a bad answer.

units.rawText: If that's the decision you've made, Professor, then I know what I have to do.
units.displayText: If that's the decision you've made, Professor, then I know what I have to do.

spans.text: If that's the decision you've made, Professor, then I know what I have to do.

units.rawText: I'll sweep clean the false stardust on your way to the true sky that lays beyond.
units.displayText: I'll sweep clean the false stardust on your way to the true sky that lays beyond.
